node.statement: Case C_col=0. Do not apply node 1.2 and do not form 1/(2*C_col). By validated node 1.2.1, available because e<e_col, |q_T(U)^2-||U||_{n,1}^2|<=C_col*e*||U||_{n,1}^2=0 for T=P,R. Hence q_T(U)^2=||U||_{n,1}^2. Since q_T(U)>=0 by its square-root definition and ||U||_{n,1}>=0 by the norm axioms, q_T(U)=||U||_{n,1}, and therefore ||U||_{n,1}<=sqrt(2)*q_T(U).
